name: Opening
purpose: Reach the right person, establish identity, and verify if they are still with the company.
they_may_say: "Yes, speaking. Who is this?"
"Aap kisse baat karna chahte hain? Wrong number, he left two years ago."
"Haan ji, boliye, regarding what?"
what_happened_options: Bad connection / asked to call back

relative_texts.Gatekeeper / switchboard assistant: He is in a meeting right now, what is this regarding?
relative_texts.Wrong number / person left company: Aap kisse baat karna chahte hain? Wrong number, he left two years ago.
relative_texts.Bad connection / asked to call back: Awaaz nahi aa rahi hai, please call me back after some time.

placeholder: e.g. 'He left the company two years ago' or 'Yes, speaking'

name: Purpose
purpose: Say in one or two sentences why you called, in words the prospect can repeat to a colleague.
they_may_say: "From where? Can you say the company name again?"
"Where did you get my number from?"
"What does a growth report mean? Is this a sales call?"
what_happened_options: Asked what company does / asked to repeat
Asked where we got their contact info

relative_texts.Understood purpose & willing to listen: Regarding what? Yes, please go ahead.
relative_texts.Asked what company does / asked to repea: From where? Can you say the company name again?
relative_texts.Asked where we got their contact info: Where did you get my contact number from?
relative_texts.Suspected sales call / defensive: What does a growth report mean? Is this a sales call?

placeholder: e.g. 'What does Meridian do exactly, are you consulting or media?'

name: Permission
purpose: Find out whether they are willing to talk now or if a specific callback time is needed.
they_may_say: "Haan boliye, go ahead, I can speak for 2 minutes."
"I am driving / in a meeting right now, call me after 30 minutes."
"Drop a message or send it on WhatsApp first."
what_happened_options: Busy now (asked to call back later)

relative_texts.Granted permission (go ahead): Haan boliye, go ahead, I can speak for 2 minutes.
relative_texts.Busy now (asked to call back later): I am driving / in a meeting right now, call me after 30 minutes.
relative_texts.Requested WhatsApp / email before talkin: Drop a message or send it on WhatsApp first.
relative_texts.Flat refusal / not interested: Not interested right now, thank you.

placeholder: e.g. 'I am in a client meeting right now, please call after 30 minutes'

name: Their business
purpose: Ask about their company and operations before saying anything about your solutions.
they_may_say: "We are a small-scale manufacturer doing job work, not corporate."
"We are an MNC back office, all strategic decisions happen in the US."
"I am only looking after plant/technical operations, not company growth."
what_happened_options: Clarified they are job work / domestic only
Identified as MNC subsidiary / back office

relative_texts.Clarified they are job work / domestic o: Review discipline? These are corporate words. We are a small-scale company, sir.
relative_texts.Shared operational model & scale: We operate 2 plant shifts and supply to local B2B distributors only.
relative_texts.Identified as MNC subsidiary / back offi: We are an MNC back office, all strategic decisions happen in the US.
relative_texts.Prospect is wrong functional domain: I am only looking after plant/technical operations, not company growth.

placeholder: e.g. 'Review discipline? Corporate words. We are a small job work chemical manufacturer'

name: Their need, in their words
purpose: Hear what they are trying to achieve or struggling with in their own exact words.
they_may_say: "Margins are fixed in job work; we need help getting into new high-value products."
"Our biggest bottleneck is skilled manpower and plant capacity."
"Everything is running fine with existing clients; we don't have any constraints."
what_happened_options: Claimed no needs / satisfied with current setup
Asked what caller can specifically do for them

relative_texts.Named specific bottleneck (margins / pro: We majorly work on job work. The margin is technically hardly any. Looking for people who can help me with new products with our facility.
relative_texts.Stated skilled manpower / hiring challen: Our biggest bottleneck right now is skilled manpower and plant capacity.
relative_texts.Claimed no needs / satisfied with curren: Everything is running fine with existing clients; we don't have any constraints.
relative_texts.Asked what caller can specifically do fo: What specifically can you help our manufacturing line with?

placeholder: e.g. 'As soon as I increase margins clients leave; looking for people to help with new products with our facility'

name: Objection
purpose: Hear the reason for hesitation and understand it rather than talking over it.
they_may_say: "I don't want to spend any money on this, no. Be very specific."
"We already have global consultants / agencies under long-term contract."
"I am not the right person, talk to our MD or head office."
what_happened_options: Skeptical of value / requested deck first

relative_texts.Budget / cost objection (not spending mo: I don't want to spend any money on this, no. I'll be very specific. What is your product?
relative_texts.Existing consultant / agency in place: We already have global consultants / agencies under long-term contract.
relative_texts.Not decision-maker (referred to MD/HO): I am not the right person, talk to our MD or head office.
relative_texts.Skeptical of value / requested deck firs: Send your deck first, let me see if it's worth our time.

placeholder: e.g. 'I do not want to spend any money on this, no. What is your product?'

name: Next step
purpose: Agree on one concrete action: document on WhatsApp/email, or a call at a named time.
they_may_say: "Send your deck/report on WhatsApp first, let me review it."
"Call me next Wednesday afternoon after 2 PM."
"Note down the number of our Operations Head and speak to him."
what_happened_options: Agreed to receive report on WhatsApp / email
Received referral to decision-maker with contact

relative_texts.Agreed to receive report on WhatsApp / e: Aap na mujhe WhatsApp pe bhej dijiye, let me first go through it. Can I call you on Wednesday? Yeah, aaram se.
relative_texts.Scheduled specific callback day & time: Call me next Wednesday afternoon after 2 PM.
relative_texts.Received referral to decision-maker with: Note down the number of our Operations Head and speak to him.
relative_texts.Prospect declined any next step: No, please do not send anything right now.

placeholder: e.g. 'Send it by Monday on WhatsApp, call me on Wednesday afternoon'

name: Close
purpose: End the call clearly, confirm the agreed expectation, and log the outcome accurately.
they_may_say: "Yeah, aaram se, take your time, send it and we will connect Wednesday."
"Done, chalega, let us talk next week."
"Please do not call this number again."
what_happened_options: Next step agreed, awaiting document review
Explicit Do Not Call / hostile exit

relative_texts.Confirmed follow-up commitment & closed: Yeah, aaram se, take your time, send it and we will connect Wednesday.
relative_texts.Next step agreed, awaiting document revi: Done, chalega, let us talk next week.
relative_texts.Explicit Do Not Call / hostile exit: Please do not call this number again.

placeholder: e.g. 'Yeah, aaram se, take your time. Done, thank you.'
